autoLayout.description:
The {@link NodeDiagram} will be automatically laid out on "INITIAL_RENDER" and after every request to {@link NodeDiagram#diagramUpdateAction}
with {@link NodeDiagramUpdateType.SET_DIAGRAM}.

ignoreHiddenNodes.description:
Whether the layout should allow hidden nodes to participate in layout calculations.
If true, hidden nodes will be positioned by the layout algorithm and considered ready for layout.
If false, hidden nodes will be excluded from layout calculations and ready checks.

localLayout.description:
Whether to enable local layout functionality. When true, only the connected component containing changed nodes
will be re-laid out instead of the entire diagram. This is more efficient for large diagrams.

algorithm.description: Algorithm to use as defined in https://eclipse.dev/elk/reference/algorithms.html

advancedOptions.description: Options to apply as defined in https://eclipse.dev/elk/reference/options.html

nodeLayoutContext.description:
Node specific context for any node's layoutOptions during execution
Options to apply as defined in https://eclipse.dev/elk/reference/options.html

title:
Layout using (Eclipse Layout Kernel)[https://www.npmjs.com/package/elkjs]
ELK's flagship is a layer-based layout algorithm that is particularly suited for node-link diagrams
with an inherent direction and ports (explicit attachment points on a node's border).
name: NodeDiagramElkLayout
